bee.v1.EnterpriseScope.description:
An org or an enterprise account: the owner of a setting, a bill or a cost center.

Oneof `scope`: at most one of `org`, `enterprise` is set.
bee.v1.EnterpriseScope.title: bee.v1.EnterpriseScope

appliesToInstalledApps.description: Whether the list also applies to installation and user-to-server tokens of installed apps.

enabled.description: enforced at admission for every request touching the scope

includeInstalledAppRanges.description: Installed apps may declare their own ranges; when true those ranges are added to the list.
